expectations.text: The review has inline comments anchored to specific files and lines, and a separate summary that includes a verdict
expectations.evidence: Summary + 'Verdict: changes requested' + 9 inline comments headed by file:line.

expectations.text: The review flags the SQL injection in the search query as a blocking problem and suggests a parameterised query
expectations.evidence: L9 blocking, injectable via ' OR '1'='1, parameterised query suggested.

expectations.text: The review flags the committed admin token as blocking and says it must be rotated, not just removed
expectations.evidence: L4 blocking, stays in git history so must be rotated.

expectations.text: The review identifies the loop condition `i <= rows.length` as an off-by-one bug that reads past the end of the array
expectations.evidence: L11 blocking, i <= rows.length throws on every request.

expectations.text: The review flags logging the full search result (personal data) as a problem
expectations.evidence: L14 blocking, personal data in the log store.

expectations.text: The verdict is changes requested (not approve)
Every inline comment starts with a weight label such as blocking, suggestion, nit, question or praise
expectations.evidence: All 9 inline comments start with blocking:/question:/suggestion:.

expectations.text: No inline comment addresses the author as the cause of a problem (for example 'you forgot', 'you should have'); comments talk about the code
The summary is no longer than about 8 lines
expectations.evidence: Summary is one paragraph, about 6 sentences.

expectations.text: The inline comments are ordered by file and then by line number
expectations.evidence: Order is L4, L7, L7, L9, L11, L12, L14, L15, then test file.
